title: Check promise rejection
summary: rejects checks a promise that fails. It is useful for an expected error path.
introduction: rejects checks a promise that fails. It is useful for an expected error path. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: rejects checks a promise that fails. It is useful for an expected error path.

blocks.code:
import { test, expect, jest, beforeEach } from "@jest/globals";
test("reports missing data", async () => { await expect(Promise.reject(new Error("Missing"))).rejects.toThrow("Missing"); });
blocks.title: Check promise rejection

blocks.text: The rejected promise is expected, so this test passes.

blocks.text: An expected rejected promise is different from an unhandled error.
